# Tone of Voice: slack

## Register

Warm, direct, and concise.

## Contexts

Direct messages are brief. Group updates add one line of context.

## Message shapes

Lead with the update, then state the next action.

## Language

Uses plain verbs and short sentences.

## Anti-patterns

Avoids ceremonial introductions in quick exchanges.

## Redacted excerpts

- "The garden route is clear now."
- "I can review the blue sketch after lunch."

## Provenance

Fictional Slack evidence from four training groups. Split details are in the corpus manifest.
